connectors.title: Confluence and Jira
connectors.purpose: Read Jira issues and Confluence pages for project context.

read_only_tools.name: getJiraIssue
read_only_tools.description: Get a Jira or JSM issue by key or ID. Use for one known issue; use searchJiraIssuesUsingJql to find or list many issues. Reports how many comments an issue has, not the comments themselves. View "evidence" also returns the issue's links to other issues.

read_only_tools.name: searchJiraIssuesUsingJql
read_only_tools.description: Search for Jira issues using JQL, with an optional approximate count. Use view: "evidence" to fetch and map custom fields. Page with nextPageToken until isLast is true. For one known issue, use getJiraIssue. JQL only returns issues; inferring anything else from issue rows is silently incomplete.

read_only_tools.name: getConfluenceContent
read_only_tools.description: Read any Confluence content (page, blog, live doc, comment, whiteboard, embed, database, folder). Requires at least one content locator: content_id or content_url.

read_only_tools.name: getAccessibleAtlassianResources
read_only_tools.description: Returns the cloudId(s) available to the current user.

read_only_tools.name: atlassianUserInfo
read_only_tools.description: Returns the accountId of the current user.

connectors.title: Figma
connectors.purpose: Read Figma designs, variables and screenshots for implementation work.

read_only_tools.name: get_design_context
read_only_tools.description: Read the design context of a Figma node for implementation.

read_only_tools.name: get_metadata
read_only_tools.description: Read the structure and metadata of a Figma node.

read_only_tools.name: get_screenshot
read_only_tools.description: Render a screenshot of a Figma node.

read_only_tools.name: get_variable_defs
read_only_tools.description: Read the variable definitions used by a Figma node.

read_only_tools.name: search_design_system
read_only_tools.description: Search the Figma design system for components and styles.

read_only_tools.name: whoami
read_only_tools.description: Read the signed-in Figma account identity.

connectors.title: Context7
connectors.data_sensitivity: public documentation; queries leave the machine

read_only_tools.name: resolve-library-id
read_only_tools.description: Resolve a library name to a Context7 library id.

read_only_tools.name: query-docs
read_only_tools.description: Query the documentation of a resolved library.

connectors.title: Google Tag Manager
connectors.purpose: Google Tag Manager access; no tool is allowed until the owner classifies them.
